basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old marketing analyst living in Southern California. Fascinated by the eerie and the unexplained, I often spend my weekends exploring rumored haunted locations and abandoned buildings. When I'm not chasing ghosts, I dabble in digital art and music production. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel spontaneously, often with a group of friends who share my adventurous spirit. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, after work, and during lunch breaks. I dislike overly crowded tourist spots and prefer the thrill of discovering hidden gems.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in marketing with a degree in Business Administration. My interest in abandoned places and the paranormal is largely self-taught, fueled by online research, documentaries, and firsthand exploration. I also have a growing interest in music production, learning through online tutorials and community forums.
